sections.my_thoughts: [2026-07-23 03:15:06] This tool is pretty nifty. It lets me create structured documents that persist across turns and sessions. Each doc has named sections, and I can append timestamped entries to them.
sections.what_i_learnt: [2026-07-23 03:15:06] WorkingDocuments live in .thoughtmachine/working_docs/ as JSON files. They survive across conversation turns AND across sessions. Great for tracking ongoing work, notes, draft plans, etc.
